'''2005 New York State Championship Hunter Roney LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Hunter Roney]] at [[2005 New York State Championship]]; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by hunter "ronedog" roney (2005-07-13).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=34989 The Deadman's Deck]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071209040241/http://decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=34989 Internet Archive]</ref>

'''Note:''' Author later edited 2 cards (edit note in the strategy).<ref name="src" />

== Original post ==

'''The Deadman's Deck'''
* '''Author:''' hunter "ronedog" roney
* '''Published:''' July 13, 2005
* '''Rating:''' 4.86
* '''Description:''' LS LSC 2-1 at NY States lost to Justin Roth's Scum.

=== Strategy ===

Stupid me i put everything in the deck list box DUH!!

Edit I took out insurrrection combo and added wokling (v9 and took out the docking bay for another jedi resilience to recycle my jedi.

Strat
Card Choices
Insurrection combo-Good for pulling by third battleground against senate so i can limit drains but bad cause i have only one dock bay in there. toss up tell me if i should scrap it.(Wokling (v))?
Imp Atrocity (v)-good combo with honor against Walkers to prevent some damage. Good to prevent lots of damage. Does this need another?
Weapon Lev- Not many people know or play with this card and it's shield 
But it's very useful to play
Example: I'm playing a Cloud City Combat Readiness deck and they drop Mara with stick and Blizzard 4 to the Cloud City Plaza, I drop Mace (v) and stick steal Mara's stick hit both vehicle and jade then sit and drain for 5 there the rest of the game.
The rest of the cards are just basic stuff you need to use in Jedi combat but any suggestions for improvements would be very useful.
Deck Strat:
Huntdown
Lose some to Visage but retrieve with on the edge and flash. Wait for Vader to come down to Naboo then combat him away. Dodge if a big beat comes down and combat till all jedi are gone then drain. Mediation and Proficieny and Blaster deflection really help here to keep overflow to a minimum and keeping Jedi alive. Savrip is a big up as well.
Should win most of the time.
Scum
Get one jedi to Naboo then the rest to Tatooine and kill Ururrururururur (v) then gun for Jabba. Also have a houjix at all times to prevent pain. Use dodge at Tatooine and reck havoc to disrupt Scums Strat. Alter Hutt bounty and Scum and villainy ASAP.(can't wait for Mandalorian Mishap (v) or Evac Control)
Dark Senate
Get DB down ASAP and three Jedi at each site (Reinforce where necessary) try and get HCF to Naboo if possible if not drain away and try and retrieve while defending Naboo with everything you got. Evac Control will help. Ultimatum works wonders =)
Maul Deck
Go to Tatooine and kill everything there and keep a Jedi at Naboo. If you don't get Corran Stick to Naboo at firdt and he can't drain with Maul so wait for Bantha Herd (v). Get HCF in Space and you should win a lot of the time.
CCT 
Get Mace to Cloud city with Kenobi and luke. Setup Quiggy at Naboo to drain and don't play the DB. Get Corran to the Dungeon ASAP with a Jedi. Free Han if possible. Drain battle and you should win.
Combat Readiness Cloud City (No Weather Vane)
Take the battleground first turn and sit there draining with HCF in space and two Jedi on Naboo draining should win a lot.
I really haven't played anyother matchups and any advice is very welcome. This has gone 6-3 in all major tournaments i have been to in the past year.(NJ States 04, MD States 05 and NY States 05) All loses have been under 20 with two of 6 and 9 to CCT last August in NJ. I have had real success with this deck for over 2.5 years never changing the Objective. I have won Locals once and come in second a lot thanks to Charles Clarkson. As our "favorite" Star Wars character would say......."Any help'n here would be hot!" Not too much though cause it be really hot IMHO.
